about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Traveloka on the Financial Services & Corporate Travel teams. For 4+ years I've designed and built systems that handle real money and real travel for thousands of corporate clients — from Flight Insurance add-ons to Loan Repayment workflows to automated invoicing.
about.p2: My day-to-day mixes Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven architectures, and AWS infrastructure managed via Terraform. I care a lot about system design, query performance, secure dependencies, and mentoring teammates into sharper engineers.
about.p3: Before Traveloka I interned at DNArtworks shipping brand sites for Vespa and Piaggio, and spent two years assisting at Parahyangan Catholic University. I'm an ICPC Asia Regional alum (Rank 10) and a continuous AWS learner.

exp.title: Where I've worked
exp.tl_b1: Led system design and implementation of Flight Insurance Add-ons on AWS — generated USD 200K net revenue and 14.45% attachment rate for corporate flight purchases in year one.
exp.tl_b2: Optimized database performance by 99% by resolving data-type mismatches forcing Parallel Seq Scans — reduced query latency from 7,969 ms → 0.057 ms via efficient Index Scan utilization.
exp.tl_b3: Designed and shipped Loan Repayment, Loan Creation (with maker-checker workflow & tenure simulation), and Loan Insurance features integrating third-party providers.
exp.tl_b4: Built an automated Hardcopy invoice generation tool for internal Ops — reduced manual processing by 60% and improved billing efficiency.
exp.tl_b5: Acted as Corporate Travel DevSecOps Champion — drove dependency security initiatives, brought critical vulnerabilities to zero via continuous monitoring, patching, and quarterly audits.
exp.tl_b6: Mentored junior engineers, raising code quality, productivity, and PR discipline.
exp.dn_b1: Built company websites for Vespa, Piaggio, Aprilia, and Moto Guzzi (Indonesia) end-to-end.
exp.dn_b2: Stack: CodeIgniter (backend), Bootstrap (frontend), MySQL, Docker, GitLab CI.
exp.un_b1: Assisted teaching: Algorithm & Data Structure, Computer Graphics, Mobile Programming, Computational Thinking, Information & Database Management.
